text:
aj: Heads up — Zephyr (enterprise) opened a reserved commit ask for EU-West for Q3/Q4. They want a ~40 GPU steady commit with a 25% seasonal safety pool. Spreadsheet: https://tinyurl.com/zephyr-commit

maria: Are those 40 A100s or equivalent? region constraints?

aj: They specified "40 v100-eq" in their SOW but we should convert to our v2 metric. They said most traffic is inference short seq (<128 tokens).

devon: If it's <128 tokens we can use smaller models / 80% effective throughput. Rough calc:
```
committed_gpus = 40
estimated_peak_multiplier = 1.25  # seasonal
buffer = 0.20
provision = committed_gpus * estimated_peak_multiplier * (1+buffer)
# => 40 * 1.25 * 1.2 = 60
```
So they'd want ~60 GPU capacity reserved in EU-west to meet peaks assuming no routing to other regions.

rachel: Sales is pushing to cap cost. They offered a 12% premium for guaranteed latency SLOs. Thoughts?

maria: We can propose a tiered burst model: committed 40 w/ 48 guaranteed pool, plus pay-as-you-go burst to 60. That reduces our upfront infra.

devon: Network note: eu-west-3 racks are under maintenance in sept, reduce available spare. Can't promise burst beyond 55 there. Need cross-region routing to eu-central as fallback.

aj: @rachel can we get permission to include EU-central fallback? Zephyr is sensitive about data residency but ok with fallback for short tails if encrypted and logged.

rachel: I'll check with legal now. If they accept fallback, we can add a 10% discount on the reserved commit.

capacity-bot: Allocation check: eu-west free pool = 18 gpus; eu-central free pool = 36 gpus.

maria: quick proposal to put to customer:
- Commit: 40 GPU reserved in eu-west
- Guaranteed pool: 48 GPUs (10% headroom)
- Burst: pay-as-you-go up to 60 across eu-west + eu-central
- SLA: 99.9% latency for <100ms with 12% premium
- Pricing: base commit rate, plus burst at 1.8x hosted rate

aj: I'll draft the SOW. Tagging infra for final capacity check once legal confirms fallback.

devon: FYI, ops will need a pre-warm plan 48h before anticipated campaign spikes; add to runbook.

rachel: Thanks all :raised_hands:

aj: putting the draft in the deal folder: https://tinyurl.com/zephyr-sow-draft

ops-bot: Runbook task created: #task-4321 — pre-warm EU pools 48h prior.

maria: closing loop — target to send customer proposal by EOD Friday.
